schema.text: Without a car, do you give up trying or find it very hard to travel with small children and their things (pushchair, bags)?

ar.#Without a car, do you give up trying or: بدون سيارة، هل تتخلى عن المحاولة أو تجد صعوبة بالغة في التنقل مع أطفال صغار وأغراضهم (عربة أطفال وحقائب)؟

de.#Without a car, do you give up trying or: Verzichten Sie ohne Auto darauf oder fällt es Ihnen sehr schwer, mit kleinen Kindern und ihren Sachen (Kinderwagen, Taschen) unterwegs zu sein?

en.#Without a car, do you give up trying or: Without a car, do you give up trying or find it very hard to travel with small children and their things (pushchair, bags)?

fa.#Without a car, do you give up trying or: بدون خودرو، آیا از تلاش دست می‌کشید یا برایتان خیلی سخت است که با کودکان کوچک و وسایلشان (کالسکه، کیف) سفر کنید؟

fr.#Without a car, do you give up trying or: Sans voiture, renoncez-vous à essayer ou trouvez-vous très difficile de voyager avec de jeunes enfants et leurs affaires (poussette, sacs) ?

hu.#Without a car, do you give up trying or: Autó nélkül lemond arról, vagy nagyon nehéznek találja, hogy kisgyerekekkel és a holmijukkal (babakocsi, táskák) utazni?

it.#Without a car, do you give up trying or: Senza auto, rinunci o fai molta fatica a spostarti con bambini piccoli e le loro cose (passeggino, borse)?

tr.#Without a car, do you give up trying or: Arabanız olmadan, küçük çocuklarla ve eşyalarıyla (bebek arabası, çantalar) yolculuk etmekten vazgeçiyor veya bunu çok zor buluyor musunuz?
